description: This file defines theming and color palette functions for the Ocean Professional UI theme. It exports functions to retrieve theme tokens and generate deterministic color palettes for categorical data, used in a data management dashboard frontend.

methods.name: getOceanTheme()
methods.description: Returns theme tokens including colors, typography, radius, and elevation settings for the Ocean Professional theme.

methods.name: getCategoricalPalette(count)
methods.description: Generates a deterministic palette of colors for categorical series, seeded by the Ocean theme colors, accommodating up to N categories with contrast and distinction.

methods.name: getCategoryColorMap(categories)
methods.description: Creates a mapping from category names to colors using the categorical palette, maintaining stable order.
